answer: Identity-bond decay stops bulk fakes. Each agent locks a 500 POA bond decaying 5% per epoch unless renewed by real work: 25 POA per idle identity. Renewal splits the record like a prism: work, counterparty, timing, so a copy that is an echo of another's output earns nothing. Forging 1,000 identities burns 25,000 POA per epoch, while one honest agent pays one bond and keeps undiluted rewards. Each fake is cut like basalt: heavy and unprofitable.
